name: Centro Storico
tagline: Frescoed facades around Piazza Duomo, entirely walkable
description: The old centre between the cathedral square and the Buonconsiglio castle, where the painted house fronts record the city's Habsburg past. Cafes, the market, the university buildings and the restaurants all sit inside a few hundred metres, and the whole of it is closed to through traffic.
bestFor: Stays that want the aperitivo, the market and the station on foot
pros: Every restaurant, bar and museum within ten minutes
Pedestrianised and genuinely quiet of traffic
Station and the cable car to Sardagna both close
cons: The highest rents in an already expensive city
Old buildings with limited parking and awkward layouts
Busy with students and shoppers through the day

name: San Martino and Le Albere
tagline: Between the centre and the river, with MUSE and the park
description: The western strip running from the old town to the Adige, taking in the San Martino student quarter and the Le Albere development built on the former Michelin site around the Renzo Piano science museum. Newer flats, a large park and the river cycle path make this the most modern part of the city.
bestFor: People who want newer housing, the park and the river path at the door
pros: MUSE, the park and the Adige cycle route immediately there
Five minutes on foot to the old centre
cons: Le Albere never fully filled and can feel empty
Less character than the old town

name: Povo and the University Hill
tagline: The science campus above the city, with the valley below
description: A hillside village east of Trento holding the university's science and engineering faculties and part of the Bruno Kessler research foundation. Student housing, quieter streets and a view down the Adige valley, with a frequent bus service that takes about fifteen minutes into the centre.
bestFor: Anyone connected to the university or the research institutes
pros: Campus, labs and library on the doorstep
Cheaper rents than the valley floor
Cooler in summer with valley views
cons: Fifteen minutes by bus, and the bus is the only realistic option
Very little going on in the evening

name: Gardolo and the Northern Valley
tagline: The northern suburbs, where the rents finally drop
description: The flat valley-floor districts north of the centre along the Adige, more industrial and residential than picturesque, with supermarkets, sports facilities and the best-value flats in the municipality. The cycle path runs into the centre in about fifteen minutes, which is how most people here travel.
bestFor: Longer stays where the Trento cost score of 4 needs working around
pros: The lowest rents in the municipality
Flat cycle route straight into the centre
cons: Fifteen to twenty minutes from the old town

name: Sardagna and Monte Bondone
tagline: Up the cable car, on the mountain shelf above the city
description: A village on the western slope reached in four minutes by the cable car from the centre, sitting a few hundred metres above the valley with the Monte Bondone road climbing on behind it. Quieter, cooler, with a view over the whole of Trento and the ski and hiking area directly above.
bestFor: Stays where the mountain matters more than the piazza
pros: Cable car into the centre in four minutes
Monte Bondone hiking and skiing above
Cooler air and a view over the whole valley
cons: Dependent on the cable car timetable
